data.gender_notes: Hesediel is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Hesediel is recorded in name-lists as “Kindness, Mercy, Loving-kindness”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hesediel expresses “Kindness, Mercy, Loving-kindness”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hesediel total 40, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

in_hebrew.name: חֶסֶדְיֵאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: חֶסֶדְיֵאל הוא שם עברי שפירושו אלוהים הוא חסדי, מורכב משורש חסד והשם המפורש אלוהים, משמעותו היא רחמים וחמלה, והוא משקף את האהבה והטוב האלוהי

in_greek.name: Ἑσεδιήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἑσεδιήλ ἐστιν ὄνομα Ἑβραϊκόν, τὸ ὁποῖον σημαίνει ὁ Θεὸς ἔστι χάρις, ἐκ τῆς ρίζος χέσεντ καὶ τοῦ ὀνόματος Θεός, ἡ σημασία του εἶναι ἡ χάρις καὶ ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ Θεοῦ

in_latin.name: Hesediel
in_latin.long_meaning: Hesediel est nomen Hebraicum, quod significat Deus est gratia, compositum ex radice chesed et nomine Dei, significatio eius est gratia et amor Dei, qui reficit et salvat homines
